ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_aankomst.desc: Walk through the Inheritance Gate. Well... it's a bit of a fixer-upper. Bushes, nettles, molehills. But the &dHomestead&r is still standing!
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_akker.desc: Build a &dField&r and pick a crop: grain, pink grain, carrots, flowers or fluffballs.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_akker.title: Sow It Begins
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_bedankje.desc: Sometimes a neighboring village sends a &ddeco piece&r as a thank-you after an order. Get one!
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_bezoek.title: Peeking at the Neighbors
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_bezwaar.desc: &dThe Great Nibble Case&r: the trial against Morris-Mika (Homestead 9 and The Preparation). Pick the right evidence and shout: OBJECTION, NYEG!
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_bezwaar.title: OBJECTION, NYEG!
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_bij.desc: Build a &dBee Yard&r: honey and wax.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_bij.title: Buzzguhs
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_bosje.title: Wood for the Stove
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_brief.desc: About half an hour of playtime after your first visit to the Guhmension, the &dPostguh&r drops by with a letter from realtor &dGuhrrit&r. For you? Nyeg!
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_brief.title: Guh've Got Mail!
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_brood.title: Fresh from the Baker
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_bulk_thuis.de: Send &e5,000&r logs, clay, sand, glass shards and Site Shed blocks home.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_cafe.desc: Build the &dVillage Café&r: everyone works a little harder with coffee.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_cafe.title: Coffee at The Chonky Cow
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_deco.title: A Touch of Cozy
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_detective.des: Build a &dDetective Agency&r. Sherlock Guh and Doctor Chonkson move in, and you get a magnifying glass!
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_dorpszender.d: Make a &dVillage Transmitter&r (a Chonk Transmitter with crystals and a block of cheese nibbles) and put it on your chonk power net.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_eend.desc: Build a &dDuck Pond&r: down and little duck eggs.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_eend.title: Quack, Guh
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_eerste_bestel: Deliver a first order to a neighboring village (the &dMarket Square&r, or click a cart on the world map).
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_eerste_bewone: Build a &dGuh Hut&r: a resident will move in all by themselves. Residents work in your buildings.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_eerste_pluk.d: Clear a &dclump&r in the top view: a bush, a boulder, an old cart. Sometimes there's something fun underneath!
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_feest.desc: Build the &dBandstand&r. Music, cake, party! (And everything goes just a little faster.)
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_feest.title: Village Party!
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_fontein.desc: Place the &dSquirtguh Fountain&r in your village (deco shop, from Homestead 6). Pfffft!
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_fontein.title: Squirtguh
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_gekleurde_wol: Dye white wool from your village at home (Dye Bath, Color Mill) and hand in the &dcolored wool&r at the counter.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_glas.title: Crystal Clear
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_goede_buur.de: Collect &e25 neighbor stamps&r with Lend a Hand.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_groeve.title: Stone by Stone
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_handje.desc: On the world map, click &eLend a Hand&r at another player's village.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_handje.title: Lend a Hand
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_hekje.desc: When you buy it you get a &dInheritance Gate&r (and a Delivery Chest). Put the gate in your base: that's your little door to your very own farm.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_hekje.title: A Gate to Your Farm
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_hoeve_10.desc: Your Homestead at &elevel 10&r: the Great Snuggle Homestead! Grandpa Nibble would be so proud.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_hoeve_2.desc: Your Homestead at &elevel 2&r. Realtor Guhrrit thinks it looks fine like this and goes on vacation. With a sombrero.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_hoeve_2.title: Bye-Bye, Realtor!
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_hoeve_3.desc: Your Homestead at &elevel 3&r: pink roof tiles! Don't forget your &dStorage Barn&r: more room for all your stuff.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_hoeve_3.title: Pink Roof Tiles
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_hoeve_4.desc: Your Homestead at &elevel 4&r. It's starting to look like something, guh.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_hoeve_4.title: A Real Little Farm
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_hoeve_5.desc: Your Homestead at &elevel 5&r: half-timbering, and plushies everywhere. So cozy!
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_hoeve_5.title: Half-Timbered and Huggable
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_hoeve_6.desc: Your Homestead at &elevel 6&r. The neighbors are looking a little jealous.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_hoeve_6.title: A Homestead with Flair
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_hoeve_7.desc: Your Homestead at &elevel 7&r: gold and chonk. Very wahoog.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_hoeve_7.title: A Touch of Chonk
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_hoeve_8.desc: Your Homestead at &elevel 8&r. A real manor farm, with a guh as lord of the manor.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_hoeve_8.title: Lord of the Manor
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_hoeve_9.desc: Your Homestead at &elevel 9&r: pastel colors and twinkly lights everywhere.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_hoeve_9.title: Pastels and Twinkles
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_hoger_dorp.de: Deliver an order to a village that is &ehigher&r than yours.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_kaars.desc: Make your first &dcandles&r at the &dCandle Maker's&r (it runs on chonk power).
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_kaars.title: Light the Candles
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_kaart.desc: Press &eF10&r: the &dworld map&r with all the villages and carts.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_kaart.title: On the Map
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_kaartjes.desc: Collect all &e8 postcards&r from realtor Guhrrit: 3 under the clumps, 5 he sends by Postguh from his vacation (Homestead 3 to 7). They go on the postcard board.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_kaas.title: Cheesemaker Guh
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_kavel.desc: Buy a first extra &dplot&r of land in the top view.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_kavel.title: More Land!
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_kavels_alle.d: Buy &eall 16 plots&r. As far as the eye can see: all yours!
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_kippenhok.des: Build your first &dChicken Coop&r. The first one is free!
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_kleurglas.des: Pick a &dcolor&r for your candles at the Candle Maker's. Making color costs chonk power!
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_knus_1000.des: &e1,000 Coziness&r: buildings, little paths and deco.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_knus_2500.des: &e2,500 Coziness&r. It really doesn't get cozier.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_koe.title: Moo-Guh
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_koek.desc: Bake your first &dcake&r in the Bakery.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_koek.title: A Cookie with Your Coffee
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_konijn.title: Fluffy Little Ears
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_koop.desc: Read the letter and click &eBuy for 1 cheese nibble&r. A whole farm for one cheese nibble! Structural report: chonky. Emotional report: very chonky.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_koop.title: One Nibble, What a Bargain
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_leverkist.des: You get a &dDelivery Chest&r when you buy the farm, and you can make more. That's where the mail from your village arrives.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_loket.desc: Hand in something from your pockets at the &dBuilding Supplies Counter&r. Big upgrades need stuff from the real world.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_loket.title: At the Counter
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_mammoet.desc: Build the &dMammoth Meadow&r. With enough chonk power the little mammoths don't sleep, and they make mountains of giant wool.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_mammoet.title: A Very Woolly Surprise
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_molen.title: The Mill Keeps Turning
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_naar_huis.des: Send stuff from your village to your &dDelivery Chest&r (button &eSend Home&r).
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_overzicht.des: Press &eF9&r: the &dtop view&r of your farm. That's where you build, clear and arrange everything.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_pension.desc: Build a &dGuh Guesthouse&r and let one of your own guhs stay over.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_pension.title: Sleepover!
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_planken.title: Sawdust Everywhere
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_reuzenwol.des: Your first &dgiant wool&r from the little mammoths.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_ring_1.desc: Clear &e16 clumps&r: the whole inner ring is clean.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_ring_1.title: Neat and Tidy
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_ring_2.title: All the Way to the Woods
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_ring_3.desc: Clear &eall 72 clumps&r. Not a nettle in sight!
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_ring_3.title: Nettle-Free Zone
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_schaap.title: Baa Baa Guhsheep
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_speeltuin.des: Build a &dPlayground&r: even more residents will come for that.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_sterbestellin: Every day there's one &6golden star&r order. Deliver one!
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_stof.desc: Weave your first &dfabric&r at the &dWeaving Mill&r.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_stof.title: Weave, Weave
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_timmer.desc: Build a &dCarpentry Barn&r: a second builder! At level 7 a third one joins too (with a coffee break).
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_timmer.title: Two Extra Pairs of Paws
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_vadsmast.desc: Build the &dChonk Mast&r and get &e40 chonk power&r to arrive from your Village Transmitter.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_vondst.desc: Find an old &ddeco piece&r while clearing up (or the old tractor).
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_vondst.title: What's This Doing Here?
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_werkplaats.de: Pick which Site Shed blocks the &dBuilding Block Workshop&r makes (something other than just the pink pastel brick).
A &dSheepfold at level 7&r (and your Homestead at 7 too): then the &dcloud lambs&r come, with extra fluff.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_zaak_blikje.d: Solve the case &dThe Tin Under the Little Tree&r. It starts when your Homestead reaches level 8 (and the case before it is solved). Sniff around, hear witnesses, string up clues: whodunit?
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_zaak_blikje.t: Case 9: The Tin Under the Little Tree
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_zaak_eieren.d: Solve the case &dThe Vanished Eggs&r. It starts when the Detective Agency is built (and the case before it is solved). Sniff around, hear witnesses, string up clues: whodunit?
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_zaak_kelder.d: Solve the case &dGrandpa Nibble's Cellar&r. It starts when your Homestead reaches level 5 (and the case before it is solved). Sniff around, hear witnesses, string up clues: whodunit?
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_zaak_koeienbe: Solve the case &dThe Stolen Cowbell&r. It starts when you build a Bandstand (and the case before it is solved). Sniff around, hear witnesses, string up clues: whodunit?
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_zaak_kruimels: Solve the case &dThe Trail of Crumbs&r. It starts when you build a Bakery (and the case before it is solved). Sniff around, hear witnesses, string up clues: whodunit?
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_zaak_licht.de: Solve the case &dLight in the Cellar&r. It starts when you build a Candle Maker's (and the case before it is solved). Sniff around, hear witnesses, string up clues: whodunit?
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_zaak_paaltjes: Solve the case &dThe Moved Posts&r. It starts when your Homestead reaches level 7 (and the case before it is solved). Sniff around, hear witnesses, string up clues: whodunit?
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_zaak_spook.de: Solve the case &dThe Ghost in the Shed&r. It starts when your Homestead reaches level 4 (and the case before it is solved). Sniff around, hear witnesses, string up clues: whodunit?
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_zaak_spook.ti: Case 3: The Ghost in the Shed
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_zaak_voorbere: Solve the case &dThe Preparation&r. It starts right after the can (and the case before it is solved). Sniff around, hear witnesses, string up clues: whodunit?
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.erfenis_zaak_wol.desc: Solve the case &dThe Vanished Wool&r. It starts with a Weaving Mill and 10 orders (and the case before it is solved). Sniff around, hear witnesses, string up clues: whodunit?
ftb.guhs_erfenis.q.intro_guhs_erfenis.de:
This chapter comes after &dWelcome to the Guhmension!&r in &dThe Guhmension&r: half an hour later the &dPostguh&r brings you a letter from realtor &dGuhrrit&r.

Grandpa Nibble's old farm is for sale, for &eone cheese nibble&r! A bit of a fixer-upper... Clear it up, build your Homestead up to level 10, let residents move in, deliver orders to the neighbors, send stuff home and solve the mystery of the farm with &dSherlock Guh&r.

The quests about your village tick themselves off as soon as your village gets that far. Nothing is locked: every quest ticks itself off as soon as you've done it, even if you did it earlier. The headings show what logically comes after what. Tick this off and get chonkily to work!
ftb.guhs_erfenis.slot.erfenis_ftb.line.0: Morris-Mika has his Little Nibble Parking...
ftb.guhs_erfenis.slot.erfenis_ftb.line.1: but he's still giving your village a very chonky look.
ftb.guhs_erfenis.slot.erfenis_ftb.title: Mika Raids: coming soon!
ftb.guhs_erfenis.title: &6A Fixer-Upper!
